findings.title: Total deadline still depends on the potentially stalled operator and persistence
findings.reason: The 110-second timer waits for durable(deadline-checkpoint) before exiting. A pending open/write/fsync never reaches its finally; the normal final path clears the timer before durable(result). Initial reservation is also outside the timer. Therefore the promised <=120-second total is not enforced, including the exact storage-stall boundary already identified in O16.
findings.requiredFix: Use an independent total-deadline observer armed before the supervised operation. It must terminate only the operator, never the detached personal center/runner/Web, and must not wait on checkpoint I/O before enforcing termination. Keep original durable reservation and unknown lock/state. A best-effort final checkpoint must not become the lifetime authority.
findings.validation: Source-only review; no fault stand-in, service, PG, or test executed.
